prompts.scratch:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic animated desktop pet sprite sheet. Input image is a character identity reference, not a layout to reproduce. Same adult stocky brown mackerel tabby cat, olive-green eyes, cream chin, dark ringed tail, realistic fur and natural cat anatomy. Create EXACTLY eight full-body isolated cat poses in a strict 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent background; equal square cells, large transparent gutters, no captions. Cat faces right in three-quarter side view throughout. This is a vertical scratching board animation; board is INVISIBLE and must not be drawn. During scratching, hind feet stay planted at one same point on ground, spine lengthens naturally, front paws grip an invisible vertical plane just to the right of the cat. The two forepaws must have distinct positions and alternate high/low; no human arms. Head scale and body identity consistent across frames, no camera or lighting changes.
Row one left to right: 1 seated neutral adult tabby; 2 standing four feet, head turns to look upward at invisible board, body occupies left side; 3 rises onto hind feet, both forepaws reach forward at chest height and hook on plane; 4 extended standing cat, LEFT forepaw high reaching, RIGHT forepaw distinctly lower pulling down with flexed elbow.
Row two left to right: 5 same standing cat reverse stroke RIGHT forepaw high and LEFT forepaw pulling down, stable hindfeet and tail gently curls back; 6 fullest natural upward stretch with both front paws high, long spine, head between forelegs, rearfeet grounded (no floating/jumping); 7 releases and lowers front shoulders toward four-feet standing, head turned slightly back; 8 seated neutral again.
All scratching-pose paw tips at same invisible vertical contact x, contact is visible in their curled toes; emphasize shoulder movement and elbows bending, full tail included, paws and ears uncropped. Each cat completely inside its cell. No board, toys, furniture, floors, shadows, text, borders, watermark, new cats, collars or accessories.
prompts.scratch_board: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent prop for photorealistic desktop cat animation. A single freestanding VERTICAL FLAT rectangular sisal scratching BOARD, NOT a round post. Natural light oak frame, coarse beige sisal pad, small wide stable wood base. Three-quarter view, the scratching face looks toward the left and camera so cat standing on its LEFT can put forepaws against the left edge of its front surface. Simple practical pet furniture, realistic studio material matching a realistic brown tabby pet. Full object isolated, genuinely transparent background, no cat, no toys, no text, no shadow or floor. Tall narrow rectangular board with approximate height 330 and width 80, base width 110, every edge uncropped.
